en.headline: Northeast monsoon to keep Hong Kong hot this week as showers ease
en.dek: The Observatory said a northeast monsoon will linger over southern China, with brief showers on Monday and Tuesday before generally fine, hot weather through the working week.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory, in a nine-day forecast issued at midnight on Monday, said a northeast monsoon would continue to affect southern China over the coming days. A band of cloud was expected to bring showers to the northern South China Sea and the Guangdong coast on Monday.

Monday was forecast to see sunny intervals, a few showers in the morning and evening, and daytime heat, with temperatures between 27 and 32 degrees Celsius and east to northeast winds of force 3 to 4. The chance of significant rainfall was rated medium. Tuesday was expected to be similar, with sunny periods, one or two showers around dawn and dusk, and winds occasionally reaching force 5 later.

An upper-air anticyclone covering Guangdong should bring generally fine weather from midweek. Wednesday and Thursday were forecast to be mainly sunny, 27 to 31 degrees, with a low chance of significant rain. Isolated showers may return from Friday through the weekend under easterly winds, while early next week looks partly sunny, still hot, and only occasionally showery. No official warning was in force at the time of the outlook.

zh.headline: 東北季候風持續 本周日間炎熱中期轉晴
zh.dek: 天文台表示東北季候風未來數日影響華南，周一周二早晚有驟雨，其後高空反氣旋覆蓋廣東，本周中期大致天晴炎熱。
body: 香港天文台周一零時發出的九天天氣預報指，一股東北季候風會在未來數日持續影響華南，一道雲帶則會在周一為南海北部及廣東沿岸帶來驟雨。
周一預料短暫時間有陽光，早晚有幾陣驟雨，日間炎熱，氣溫介乎27至32度，吹東至東北風3至4級，顯著降雨概率屬中等。周二部分時間有陽光，早晚有一兩陣驟雨，稍後風力間中達5級。
天文台預計，隨著高空反氣旋覆蓋廣東，本周中期天色普遍晴朗。周三及周四大致天晴，氣溫約27至31度，顯著降雨概率偏低。周五起至周末部分時間有陽光，稍後局部地區有驟雨；下周初仍然炎熱，間中有驟雨。發出預報時本港並無天氣警告生效。
